summary.name: Pencil Project
summary.one_liner: Pencil is a free, open-source GUI prototyping tool for creating UI mockups and diagrams on desktop platforms.
summary.what_it_does: Pencil is a desktop tool for building GUI mockups and prototypes that is described as free and open source. The latest stable version, 4.0.0, adds built-in AI support, letting connected AI assistants create, edit, and organize mockups directly on the canvas in real time. The page lists a universal .dmg download of about 173 MiB for version 4.0.0 and links to downloads for other platforms. The project news section shows releases dating from 2017 to 2026, with version 4.0.0 as the most recent entry.
notable: Open source and free GUI prototyping tool
Built-in AI support in version 4.0.0 for creating and editing mockups on the canvas
Downloads for all popular desktop platforms via a link to other downloads
caveats: Page does not name Windows or Linux explicitly; other platforms are only referred to as 'see all downloads'
AI features depend on connecting an external AI assistant
